style: Victorian steel-engraving illustration, fine cross-hatched linework with restrained hand-tinting in gaslight amber, claret red and slate blue. The Inns of Court, London, at dusk: Portland stone, brick staircases, gas lamps, painted name boards at doorways. Two recurring characters in every scene: a barrister in a black gown and white bands (the template author), and a small brass clockwork clerk whose head is a softly glowing lantern (the runtime). Wide 16:9 composition, full-bleed to every edge: no border, frame, vignette or rounded corners, no caption, and no text or lettering anywhere. No modern objects.

scenes.title: The Gatehouse
scenes.prompt: The arched gatehouse into an Inn of Court at dusk. The barrister and the lantern-headed clerk walk in together beneath a hanging lamp; through the arch, lit windows of chambers line a cobbled court, each doorway with a painted name board.

scenes.title: The Registry
scenes.prompt: A tall registry office lined with ledgers. A registrar re-binds old, overstuffed folios into slim new volumes on a reading stand while the clerk carries a single clean volume to the barrister. Discarded wax seals and loose envelopes lie in a basket.

scenes.title: The Conveyancer's
scenes.prompt: A conveyancer's desk where a large deed is being bound with red tape. A separate smaller folio is being stitched into it as a sewn-in section; the clerk holds the needle and thread while the barrister checks the binding.

scenes.title: The Strongroom
scenes.prompt: A vaulted strongroom with a wall of identical numbered pigeonholes. The clerk files a tied bundle into one pigeonhole by its tag while the barrister reads the tags; one pigeonhole stands deliberately empty.

scenes.title: The Clerks' Windows
scenes.prompt: A corridor of small service windows, each with a different carved emblem above it. Petitioners queue at the right window; the clerk directs one petitioner to the correct window while the barrister watches from a doorway.

scenes.title: The Library
scenes.prompt: A galleried law library. The barrister writes at a single desk lit by the clerk's lantern; around them, other volumes sit behind locked glass-fronted cases that can be read through the glass but not opened.

scenes.title: The Chancery
scenes.prompt: A sealing table in a chancery office. Several documents are gathered under one large brass press about to seal them all at once; the clerk lowers the press while the barrister holds a torn draft over a waste basket.

scenes.title: The Seal Office
scenes.prompt: A seal office with racks of engraved brass seal matrices, each a different crest. The clerk presses a matrix into wax on a document, and the barrister holds out the next blank document.

scenes.title: The Recorder
scenes.prompt: A recorder's office with a large public board of pinned notices, each notice stamped through a sequence of marks. The clerk pins a new stamped notice while the barrister reads an older one beside it.

scenes.title: The Moot
scenes.prompt: A practice moot in a panelled hall: a mock trial with a stand-in witness made of cardboard and wire. The barrister argues to an empty bench while the clerk keeps the record.

scenes.title: The Porters' Lodge
scenes.prompt: A porters' lodge at night. The clerk hands a sealed, numbered bundle through the lodge window to a night porter, who checks it against a numbered ledger; a second porter holds a returned bundle marked for resubmission.

scenes.title: The Roll
scenes.prompt: The great hall of the Inn by candlelight, a long parchment roll unfurled down the high table listing entries; the barrister and the clerk sign the foot of the roll together.
